Yinyang appendices

Yinyang practice overview

Forming your own Yinyang connects adopted philosophy, an understanding of the actual participants, and a shared working environment so you and the model can continue to understand, create, judge, and act.

Static reference and practical method

Full can be read, but must not be used for your own practice. It preserves The Philosophy of Stealing Fire in Skill form for inspection and understanding. Do not load the author's philosophy directly as your own commitments or the model's working instructions. A webpage is reading material; being read by a model does not give it instructional authority.

Empty provides the recursive self-improvement method. Form personal content from your own purposes, experience, material, and judgment, then revise it through actual work. The entire crossed-out Full row below marks an unavailable practice entrance. Full still exists and remains readable as a static reference.

Reference and method Direct model condensation Community-assisted condensation
Full: The Philosophy of Stealing Fire Static reference: philosophy expressed in Skill form. Static reference: philosophy and method organized within a Skill.
Empty: recursive self-improvement method The model condenses and revises personal understanding and six accounts from your own purposes and material. Hindsight or a similar project assists source retention, integration, and generation; you and the model check and revise the results.

Full reference source retains essays, diagrams, and the authored Skill form. Empty method source is the entrance for your own practice. Inspecting how the author organizes philosophy and method differs from turning that philosophy into your own practice instructions; the latter use is crossed out here.

Simple: let the model condense directly

Give the language model you currently use your own philosophical understanding, Personal material, and existing accounts. Use the six formation guides to condense, organize, and revise them directly. As model capabilities develop, let newer models reinterpret the material and improve its condensation. Keep the six files in private references/situated/, with versions in private Git/GitHub.

Complex: configure a condensation aid

Add a community project for memory and working-account formation to your Empty-based personal version. This project uses Hindsight: it retains sources, integrates observations, and forms maintained accounts from questions. The model carries configuration, checking, and revision, returning adopted results to the six accounts. The Hindsight configuration guide is the operational entrance.

Where the six accounts live and how to use them

Orientation, person, counterpart, relationship, environment, and revision live in private references/situated/; the file and update contract lists their filenames. Personal material, readable topic articles, and the source index live in references/personal/. A native implementation can also bind the six complete bodies through a private index.

For formation and revision, the model reads adopted philosophy and relevant fresh sources, corrects Personal understanding, synthesizes and reads the six accounts together, then realizes selected changes in the working environment and revises from use. Forming and revising working models develops the writing method; everyday collaboration explains reading and using the current accounts.

Begin with the material you already have

Existing philosophy, personal experience, preferences, works, or a working environment can provide the starting point. The model helps form missing connections; actual work can also change the philosophy and collaboration. For further writing, An example and a commons opens a path to personal essays and different works.
